question.:question/problem:
Consider the system of linear equations

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}5x-15y &=-25 \\ 2x-4y &=-4.\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}5 & -15 & -25 \\ 2 & -4 & -4\end{array}\right].
$$

Reducing $M$ to row echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}5 & -15 & -25 \\ 2 & -4 & -4\end{array}\right] & {R}_{1} & :=\frac{1}{5}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & -3 & -5 \\ 2 & -4 & -4\end{array}\right] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & -3 & -5 \\ 0 & 2 & 6\end{array}\right] & {R}_{2} & :=\frac{1}{2}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & -3 & -5 \\ 0 & 1 & 3\end{array}\right].\end{aligned}
$$
